scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MenuToys"):WaitForChild("SpawnToyRemoteFunction")

local targetPart = Instance.new("Part")
targetPart.Name = "NeonTargetIndicator"
targetPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
targetPart.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
targetPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
targetPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
targetPart.CanCollide = false
targetPart.Anchored = true
targetPart.Parent = Workspace

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        return
    end

    local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
    local lookVector = camCFrame.LookVector
    local pitch = math.asin(lookVector.Y)
    local alpha = math.clamp((-pitch) / (math.pi / 2), 0, 1)
    local fixedOffset = -0.66 + (alpha * (-14.9 - (-0.66)))

    targetPart.Position = camCFrame.Position + (lookVector * fixedOffset)
end)

local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FastUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = pg

local unlocked = true
local buttonSize = 55
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPositions = {}
local dragMoved = false
local clickThreshold = 8

local function makeButton(parent, text, size, position)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = size
    button.Position = position
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    button.Active = true
    button.Parent = parent

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = button

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    stroke.Thickness = 2
    stroke.Parent = button

    return button
end

local btn = makeButton(
    gui,
    "7S",
    UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize),
    UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.4, 0)
)

local mainCorner = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local helper = Instance.new("Frame")
helper.Name = "HelperPanel"
helper.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 88)
helper.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, buttonSize + 10, 0.4, -16)
helper.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)
helper.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
helper.Parent = gui

local helperCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
helperCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
helperCorner.Parent = helper

local helperStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
helperStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 65)
helperStroke.Thickness = 2
helperStroke.Parent = helper

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 2)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "AJUDANTE"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
title.TextSize = 13
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
title.Parent = helper

local spawnHelper = makeButton(
    helper,
    "spawn pattle",
    UDim2.fromOffset(58, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(7, 32)
)

local smaller = makeButton(
    helper,
    "TAM -",
    UDim2.fromOffset(38, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(69, 32)
)

local bigger = makeButton(
    helper,
    "TAM +",
    UDim2.fromOffset(38, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(111, 32)
)

local sizeLabel = makeButton(
    helper,
    tostring(buttonSize),
    UDim2.fromOffset(43, 22),
    UDim2.fromOffset(7, 63)
)

local lockButton = makeButton(
    helper,
    "🔓",
    UDim2.fromOffset(43, 22),
    UDim2.fromOffset(54, 63)
)

local function updatePanelPosition()
    helper.Position = UDim2.new(
        btn.Position.X.Scale,
        btn.Position.X.Offset + buttonSize + 10,
        btn.Position.Y.Scale,
        btn.Position.Y.Offset - 16
    )
end

local function setSize(newSize)
    buttonSize = math.clamp(newSize, 35, 100)

    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize)
    sizeLabel.Text = tostring(buttonSize)

    updatePanelPosition()
end

local function setLocked(value)
    unlocked = not value

    if unlocked then
        lockButton.Text = "🔓"
        lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
        title.Text = "AJUDANTE"
    else
        lockButton.Text = "🔒"
        lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 45, 20)
        title.Text = "AJUDANTE - TRAVADO"
    end
end

local function spawnPallet()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local spawnPosition = targetPart.Position
        local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local _, yaw, _ = camCFrame:ToOrientation()

        local newCFrame = camCFrame.Rotation + spawnPosition
        local rotationVector = Vector3.new(0, math.deg(yaw), 0)

        pcall(function()
            Event:InvokeServer(
                "PalletLightBrown",
                newCFrame,
                rotationVector
            )
        end)
    end)
end

spawnHelper.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not dragMoved then
        spawnPallet()
    end
end)

smaller.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if unlocked then
        setSize(buttonSize - 5)
    end
end)

bigger.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if unlocked then
        setSize(buttonSize + 5)
    end
end)

lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setLocked(unlocked)
end)

local function beginDrag(input)
    if not unlocked then
        return
    end

    dragging = true
    dragMoved = false
    dragStart = input.Position

    startPositions = {
        btn = btn.Position,
        helper = helper.Position
    }

    dragInput = input
end

local function updateDrag(input)
    if not dragging or not unlocked then
        return
    end

    local delta = input.Position - dragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > clickThreshold
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > clickThreshold then
        dragMoved = true
    end

    if dragMoved then
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPositions.btn.X.Scale,
            startPositions.btn.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPositions.btn.Y.Scale,
            startPositions.btn.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )

        helper.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPositions.helper.X.Scale,
            startPositions.helper.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPositions.helper.Y.Scale,
            startPositions.helper.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end

local function endDrag()
    dragging = false
    dragInput = nil
end

local function connectDrag(object)
    object.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            beginDrag(input)

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    endDrag()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    object.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragInput = input
        end
    end)
end

connectDrag(btn)
connectDrag(helper)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

-- Apertar Q spawna o pallet diretamente
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
        spawnPallet()
    end
end)

-- O botão 7S também spawna o pallet
btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if dragMoved then
        return
    end

    spawnPallet()
end)

setLocked(false)

-- ================================================================
-- SIGMA SHADERS
-- ================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Safely remove any old versions of the GUI
if playerGui:FindFirstChild("SigmaShadersGui") then
    playerGui.SigmaShadersGui:Destroy()
end

-- Global RGB Color Cycle for UI accents
local currentRGB = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local hue = (tick() * 0.15) % 1
    currentRGB = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
end)

-- Shader Toggles State Table (All Shaders Available to Combine)
local shaderStates = {
    Bloom = false,
    ColorGrade = false,
    DepthField = false,
    SunRays = false,
    UltraShine = false
}

-- Effect Object Holders
local activeEffects = {
    Bloom = nil,
    ColorGrade = nil,
    DepthField = nil,
    SunRays = nil
}

-- Shader Engine Manager (Allows stacking multiple shaders together)
local function refreshShaderEngine()
    -- 1. Cinematic Bloom Effect
    if shaderStates.Bloom then
        if not activeEffects.Bloom then
            local b = Instance.new("BloomEffect", Lighting)
            b.Intensity = 0.85
            b.Size = 35
            b.Threshold = 0.45
            activeEffects.Bloom = b
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.Bloom then activeEffects.Bloom:Destroy(); activeEffects.Bloom = nil end
    end

    -- 2. Vibrant Color Grade Effect
    if shaderStates.ColorGrade then
        if not activeEffects.ColorGrade then
            local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
            cc.Brightness = 0.04
            cc.Contrast = 0.4
            cc.Saturation = 0.35
            cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(245, 238, 255)
            activeEffects.ColorGrade = cc
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.ColorGrade then activeEffects.ColorGrade:Destroy(); activeEffects.ColorGrade = nil end
    end

    -- 3. Focal Depth Blur Effect
    if shaderStates.DepthField then
        if not activeEffects.DepthField then
            local dof = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect", Lighting)
            dof.FarIntensity = 0.4
            dof.FocusDistance = 20
            dof.InFocusRadius = 22
            activeEffects.DepthField = dof
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.DepthField then activeEffects.DepthField:Destroy(); activeEffects.DepthField = nil end
    end

    -- 4. Atmospheric Sun Rays Effect
    if shaderStates.SunRays then
        if not activeEffects.SunRays then
            local sr = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect", Lighting)
            sr.Intensity = 0.5
            sr.Spread = 1
            activeEffects.SunRays = sr
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.SunRays then activeEffects.SunRays:Destroy(); activeEffects.SunRays = nil end
    end

    -- 5. 10x Ultra Shine (Mirror World)
    if shaderStates.UltraShine then
        Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Future
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 10
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 2
        Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.1

        pcall(function()
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj.Anchored and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    -- Skip dynamic/character parts safely
                elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if obj.Material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or obj.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic or obj.Material == Enum.Material.Wood then
                        obj.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
                        obj.Reflectance = 1.0
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

--==================================================

--==================================================

local tocando = false
local arrastando = false
local inicioToque
local posicaoInicial
local inputAtivo
local LIMITE_ARRASTO = 10

toggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        tocando = true
        arrastando = false
        inicioToque = input.Position
        posicaoInicial = toggle.Position
        inputAtivo = input
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not tocando then return end

    local mouseMovendo =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

    local toqueMovendo =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        and input == inputAtivo

    if not mouseMovendo and not toqueMovendo then
        return
    end

    local delta = input.Position - inicioToque

    if delta.Magnitude > LIMITE_ARRASTO then
        arrastando = true
    end

    if arrastando then
        toggle.Position = UDim2.new(
            posicaoInicial.X.Scale,
            posicaoInicial.X.Offset + delta.X,
            posicaoInicial.Y.Scale,
            posicaoInicial.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if not tocando then return end

    local mouseSolto =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

    local toqueSolto =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        and input == inputAtivo

    if not mouseSolto and not toqueSolto then
        return
    end

    if not arrastando then
        menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
    end

    tocando = false
    arrastando = false
    inputAtivo = nil
end)
